summary: Iter107 Share Center follow-ups fully validated end-to-end. Backend pytest: 7/7 passing at /app/backend/tests/test_iter107_share_renew_log_alerts.py (11s runtime). Verified: (1) POST /api/agents/runtime/card-share/renew extends expires_at by ~14d, persists in list, returns 404 for unknown token, 401/403 unauth. (2) GET /api/agents/runtime/card-share/{token}/access-log returns opens/downloads/last_downloaded_by/access[] and starts empty; after 2 public opens + 1 PDF download with who='Jane Auditor' the endpoint returns opens=2, downloads=1, and exactly 3 access rows (2 kind=open who=null, 1 kind=download who='Jane Auditor') each with ip + at timestamps; admin /stats endpoint does NOT increment opens (still shows counters from public hits only). (3) Engagement Alerts: first public open + first public PDF download each create exactly ONE 'Shared card engagement' notification via /api/notifications (via _card_engage_alert once-only alerted_open/alerted_download flags); second open + second download do NOT create dupes — delta of engagement notifs after 2 opens + 2 downloads = 2 (not 4). Body text correctly includes auditor name for download and 'opened' verb for open. (4) Frontend UI e2e: logged in as admin, navigated /app/agentic-ai-security → Defensibility tab → Share Center; verified every row now has share-card-log-<token> and share-card-renew-<token> buttons alongside prior Board digest / Copy / Open / Revoke. Clicking Log expanded access-log-<token> panel titled 'Chain of custody — 2 open(s) · 1 download(s)' listing Jane Auditor download + 2 opens with IP 35.225.230.28 and timestamps; second click collapsed it. Clicking Renew called the API successfully (row already at max +14d from prior pytest, so expiry display unchanged). Screenshot at /app/test_reports/iter107_ui.png captures the expanded chain-of-custody panel in the Share Center.
critical_code_review_comments: _card_engage_alert relies on Mongo's atomic update_one with {flag: {$ne: True}} filter as the once-only latch — good pattern; safe under concurrent public hits.
Access log query has no index hint; db.card_share_access should get a compound index on (token, org_id, at) if this collection grows (currently .sort('at', -1).to_list(500) — 500 cap is sensible).
renew_card_share clamps days to [1,90] which is reasonable; body defaults to 14 matching the Auditor Room renew behavior.

Public /card.pdf still swallows watermark/seal errors with bare `except Exception: pass` (flagged since iter105) — engagement alert emit is inside a `try: ... except: pass` on the caller too, so a failing _notify_org_staff would not break the download. Consider structured logging in either path.

In-app notification 'kind_title' is 'Shared card engagement' (matches spec); note the underlying notifications.create dedupe_key includes token+event so replays across restarts also stay idempotent — nice.
AccessLog panel in DefensibilityDashboard.jsx is now generalized with an `endpoint` prop and reused between the Auditor Room and Share Center — good DRY win.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Renew + Log + collapse + panel content all verified)
